visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Process Each Run in One Place
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop compares each character with the previous one and has to flush the last run after the loop ends. Put the run counting into an encode method that handles each run as a unit. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The old loop runs one step past the end of the string and mixes "extend the run" with "write the run". The nested loops separate the two jobs, and the StringBuilder avoids repeated copying.
